name: System File Execution Location Anomaly
description: Detects the execution of a Windows system binary that is usually located in the system folder from an uncommon location.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:(*\\atbroker.exe OR *\\audiodg.exe OR *\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\certreq.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\cmstp.exe OR *\\conhost.exe OR *\\consent.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\csrss.exe OR *\\dashost.exe OR *\\defrag.exe OR *\\dfrgui.exe OR *\\dism.exe OR *\\dllhost.exe OR *\\dllhst3g.exe OR *\\dwm.exe OR *\\eventvwr.exe OR *\\logonui.exe OR *\\LsaIso.exe OR *\\lsass.exe OR *\\lsm.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\ntoskrnl.exe OR *\\powershell_ise.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\runonce.exe OR *\\RuntimeBroker.exe OR *\\schtasks.exe OR *\\services.exe OR *\\sihost.exe OR *\\smartscreen.exe OR *\\smss.exe OR *\\spoolsv.exe OR *\\svchost.exe OR *\\taskhost.exe OR *\\Taskmgr.exe OR *\\userinit.exe OR *\\wininit.exe OR *\\winlogon.exe OR *\\winver.exe OR *\\wlanext.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\wsl.exe OR *\\wsmprovhost.exe)) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(C\:\\$WINDOWS.\~BT\\* OR C\:\\$WinREAgent\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SoftwareDistribution\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SystemTemp\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\uus\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*)) OR (process.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\PowerShell\\7\-preview\\pwsh.exe)) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\\WindowsApps\\MicrosoftCorporationII.WindowsSubsystemForLinux* AND process.executable:*\\wsl.exe))) AND (NOT process.executable:*\\SystemRoot\\System32\\*)
